reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
Per Aetna Better Health of Illinois Policy Ambulatory EEG is indicated with a supporting 
diagnosis.

Ambulatory EEG procedures should be reported with a supporting diagnosis indicating 
seizures/convulsions.
